description:
Leidos is hiring a Modeling and Simulation Engineer with an active Secret clearance in our Beavercreek Ohio Office. The successful candidate will use strong technical capabilities and communication skills to collaborate with technical teams of engineers and scientists to integrate an infrared threat simulation into a multispectral few-on-few engagement simulation environment.
 
 Primary Responsibilities: 
 Perform tasks related to the integration of an infrared threat simulation into a multispectral few-on-few, C++ based simulation environment

 Work with a team of engineers and collaborate on team tasking

 Collaborate with teams of government and contractor personnel

 Participate in the design and implementation of tools that support the wider multispectral simulation

 Test and evaluate implementations, provide feedback to developmental team and team partners

 Develop, code and test software and prepare documentation requested by the government customer

 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in CS, CE, EE or a related field with 2+ years of applicable experience or an MS degree in CS, CE, EE, or a related field

 Experience with C++, Linux

 Experience with modeling and simulation (M&S) techniques

 Excellent English-language written and verbal communication. Strong emphasis on writing ability

 Great people skills and the desire to work with technical teams of engineers and scientists

 Ability to work independently and under deadlines in a mixed government-contractor environment

 To be considered, must have a current and active Secret security clearance

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience working with modeling and simulation, Python, GPU compute, HPC resources, EO/IR sensor phenomenology, infrared threat systems

 Previous experience with department of defense software applications

 
 
 NKE
 
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

September 14, 2026
